roguelike.title: Roguelike Mode
roguelike.description: Embark on an adventure through procedurally generated zones. Each run is unique as you face random encounters, collect creatures, and try to reach the end.

versus.title: Versus Mode
versus.description: Battle against other players in real-time matches. Build your team, strategize, and climb the ranks!

combat.title: Combat Basics
combat.description: Lunaris features turn-based combat where creatures take turns using moves, items, or switching to another creature.

types.title: Type Advantages
types.description: Each creature has one or two types. Certain types have advantages over others. Use type matchups to gain the upper hand!

abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.description: Creatures can have unique abilities that provide passive bonuses or activate under certain conditions.

collecting.title: Collecting Creatures
collecting.description: Throughout your adventure, you'll encounter wild creatures. Capture them using special items to add them to your team!

tips.title: Tips for Beginners
list: Pay attention to type advantages in battle
Build a balanced team with different types
Don't forget to use items during battle

whatIs.title: What is Lunaris?
whatIs.description: Lunaris is a modular creature-battling roguelike game where players explore procedurally generated zones, capture and train unique creatures, and engage in strategic turn-based battles.

development.title: Development
development.description: Lunaris is being developed as a modular, expandable game system. The core mechanics are designed to be flexible, allowing for easy addition of new creatures, abilities, zones, and game modes.

team.title: Development Team
team.description: Lunaris is being developed by a small team of passionate game developers.
